title: OAuth on-behalf-of for service principals is generally available
body:
OAuth on-behalf-of (OBO) for service principals is now generally available and turned on by default. With OBO, you use the standard user-to-machine (U2M) OAuth flow to act as a service principal you manage, without creating an OAuth secret. You must have the **Service Principal Manager** role on the service principal. A workspace admin no longer needs to turn on the feature from the **Previews** page.

See [Authenticate as a service principal using OAuth OBO](/aws/en/dev-tools/auth/oauth-m2m#oauth-obo).
